svg.text: 2026-11-18 NIGHT ROUND 4 (CUMULATIVE R484) · MULTI-AGENT SESSION CONTINUITY & LOCAL CODE GRAPH
ai-dialog-manage (9-Tool Transplant) + magi (Live Machine Teleport) + wingbox (Offline Code Graph)
1. haczen/ai-dialog-manage (★41 · 17 forks · MIT)
• 9-Tool Session Browser, Editor & "--transplant" Engine
Claude / Codex / OpenCode / Gemini / Qwen / Goose / Cline / Roo / JSON (~1s scan)
Deletes paired tool_use/result, repairs Claude parentUuid chain & keeps 8 backups
uv run adm --transplant 4f2a1c --to codex --cwd D:\hello converts tool schemas
2. felitrejos/magi (★12 · Rust · MIT)
• Moves live Claude Code / Codex sessions between laptop & remote server (magi move/pull)
• Carries conversation history, branch, uncommitted edits & allowlisted secrets
• Bidirectional localhost:3000 port follow + remote background build files auto-sync back
• magi doctor verifies both endpoints before handoff
3. aileron-tech/wingbox (★19 · Python/MCP · MIT)
• 100% Local Zero-Model Static Code Graph (16 Languages)
Python, TS/TSX, Rust, C#, Java, Go, Ruby/Rails, PHP/Laravel/Blade/Livewire, Dart/Flutter
Exposes dependency map, call flows & change blast radius before editing code
• ~1s Incremental Hook Refresh & Air-Gapped Windows Native
Claude Code hook patches only edited files (~1s on a 1,200-file repository)
Runs natively on Windows PowerShell/CMD (no WSL), macOS & Linux with 0 network calls
Benchmark Impact (anonymized_reported, independently_reproduced=false):
2-4x cheaper per answer · Up to 5x faster · Up to 8.8x fewer tokens
Up to $484 saved per 1,000 codebase questions with zero missed blast-radius files
